incidentbot: PagerDuty page fired -> service=embeddings-eu, severity=P1, symptom=5xx spike, route=embeddings-queue. Incident ID LGT-3591. Auto-escalation to oncall.
jamie: Acked. I'm on it and joining the bridge.
ashwin: +1 jamie, seeing a 4x increase in 5xx rate on the EU embedder from 07:12->07:15 UTC. Graph: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/embeds/queue?panel=3
maria: Noted. Any customer-facing impact? Which customers hitting embeddings heavily atm?
ana: customer-success-ana: I'm pulling the list now, will DM the sensitive list to SRE ops.
jamie: Quick triage: errors look like model workers returning 503s, downstream queue backlog rising. Trying a scale-up of the dedicated embed pool.
jamie: Running scale command now:
```
infractl pools scale --region eu-west-1 --pool embeddings-dedicated --count +3 --reason "auto pd LGT-3591"
```
tiago: tiago: Applied routing patch to divert 10% of traffic to fallback pool (dedicated warm spare). Watch for error-rate delta. :gear:
incidentbot: Escalation: L2 notified (ashwin, maria). PD escalation window set to 15m.
ashwin: After diversion, 5xx rate dropped ~35% on the primary cluster, but tail latency still elevated. Queue depth trending down.
maria: Can we enable prefix/KV cache bypass for the hot keys to reduce pressure? That was useful in previous surge.
jamie: Enabled cache-bypass for hot prefix group A (rolling change): `service-config set embeds.cache_bypass=true --selector prefix_group=A`
tiago: Confirmed bypass toggled. Observability shows immediate reduction in worker CPU on 2 nodes.
ana: customer-success-ana: I sent an interim PSA to affected enterprise customers with brief impact note and ETA for next update.
jamie: Status update: error rate down 65% from peak, majority of traffic healthy. Keeping bridge open for monitoring. Will keep PD incident open and escalate to postmortem if we see recurrence.
ashwin: Leaving a note for follow-up: we should investigate model-loading spikes + KV cache evictions as root cause.
maria: Agreed. I'll own the follow-up ticket and schedule an async post-incident eval.
jamie: Closing ops bridge in 20m unless we see regression. Next update in 10m. :white_check_mark:
incidentbot: Incident LGT-3591 updated: status=mitigated (partial), responders=[jamie,ashwin,maria,tiago,ana], timeline saved.
jamie: Thanks team. Good job on fast handoff and routing patch.
ana: customer-success-ana: I'll send a final customer update after the postmortem draft is ready.
jamie: last ping — no new spikes in the last 15m, closing thread and filing ticket LGT-3591-PR for root-cause work.
